explanation: She won at the 2010 ceremony for The Hurt Locker. Chloé Zhao in 2021 and Jane Campion in 2022 were the next two women to win.

claims.text: Kathryn Bigelow was the first woman to win the Academy Award for Best Director, at the 2010 ceremony, for The Hurt Locker.
Jane Campion won Best Director in 2022, after Bigelow, and neither Sofia Coppola nor Greta Gerwig won it before Bigelow.
Chloé Zhao won Best Director in 2021 and Jane Campion in 2022, the next two women to win.
